create.name: Davina MacKail
create.bio:
With more than 35 years of experience, Davina MacKail works as a shamanic teacher and feng shui consultant. Nursing was her first training. She took up shamanic practice in the 1990s and deepened it through the Pachakuti Mesa tradition of don Oscar Miro-Quesada and a long apprenticeship in New York with Alex Stark. She also qualified professionally in geomancy and feng shui, and for close to twenty years has taken pilgrimage groups to Peru with the Q'ero teacher Puma Fredy Quispe Singona. At London's College of Psychic Studies she was the first person to teach shamanism, and she co-founded the Ayni Foundation.

She sees the home as a living mirror of those who live in it, and her work combines classical feng shui and space clearing with astrology, tarot, the Gene Keys and shamanic ceremony. She offers consultations and mentoring online and in person, and every fortnight sends out a Moon Report, with a guided shamanic journey at each full moon. Her courses include an introduction to feng shui for Hay House and Shamanic Feng Shui on The Shift Network, and Hay House also publishes her books Feng Shui Made Easy and The Dream Whisperer.

books.title: Feng Shui Made Easy: Create Health, Wealth and Happiness through the Power of Your Home
books.author: Davina Mackail
books.description: A plain introduction to feng shui and how the layout and contents of a home shape everyday life. Davina explains the bagua, clutter clearing and space clearing, with simple changes readers can make room by room. First published as Feng Shui in the Hay House Basics series.

courses.title: Shamanic Feng Shui
courses.description: A seven-module course on reading the energy, symbolism and spirit of your home from a shamanic perspective. It includes a full space-clearing ceremony, a home limpia, creating an altar, the psychology of clutter and mapping the nine life areas of feng shui.

courses.title: Feng Shui Made Easy (Hay House online course)
courses.description: A six-lesson video course with more than three and a half hours of teaching on the history, schools and principles of feng shui. It covers the bagua, clutter, space clearing and personal enhancements, with worksheets, exercises and meditations.

courses.title: Intuitive Consultations
courses.description: Online sessions for times of change and decision, prepared in advance from your astrology, Human Design and Gene Keys and guided by the shamanic mesa and Davina's own tarot process. Sessions are recorded and the longer Foundation session includes a transcript.

free_resources.title: The Moon Report and Shamanic Journeys to the Moon
free_resources.description: A free fortnightly report on each new and full moon, with a guided shamanic journey to the drum or rattle at every full moon. A sample journey can be played on the page.
